execution.signal_fill_lag: signal on bar t close fills no earlier than bar t+1 open
execution.buy_stop_fill: max(stop, bar_open) on first bar with high >= stop
execution.limit_buy_fill: min(limit, bar_open) on first bar with low < limit (strict)
execution.stop_loss: checked from the entry bar inclusive; on the entry bar exit at stop_loss; later bars exit at min(stop_loss, bar_open) when low <= stop_loss
execution.target_D_only: from the bar after entry, resting sell limit = VWAP at the previous bar's close; fills when high >= limit at max(limit, bar_open)

daily_bars.ohlc: first open, max high, min low, last close of REGULAR 1m bars
daily_bars.valid_day: data_quality threshold met and not an early-close day
daily_bars.lookback: last k valid daily bars; may bridge non-adjacent days around invalid days
daily_bars.invalid_previous_trading_day: no B, C or D trades on day t
daily_bars.nr7: range(t-1) <= min range of last 7 valid days incl. t-1
daily_bars.nr4: range(t-1) <= min range of last 4 valid days incl. t-1
daily_bars.inside_day: H(t-1) < H(t-2) and L(t-1) > L(t-2), t-2 = previous valid day
daily_bars.stretch10: mean of min(H-O, O-L) over last 10 valid days incl. t-1
daily_bars.sma_n: mean close of last n valid days
daily_bars.true_range: max(H-L, |H-C_prev|, |L-C_prev|); first valid day uses H-L
daily_bars.atr_n: Wilder; seed = mean of first n TR; undefined before 3n valid days
daily_bars.rsi_n: Wilder; seed averages like ATR; avg_loss = 0 -> 100; both 0 -> 50; undefined before 3n values
daily_bars.rsi3_roc1: RSI(3) on ROC1 = C / C_prev - 1; undefined before 3*3 + 1 valid days
daily_bars.vwap: cumulative sum((H+L+C)/3 * volume) / cumulative volume from 09:30; zero cumulative volume -> undefined, no signal or target

arm_reduction_from_r1.pooled: QQQ 1.5% (36 days) with SOXL 4.5% (149 days) into A1
arm_reduction_from_r1.basis: count-only feasibility pass of signal conditions, no returns or fills (section count_only_pass)

arms.same_day_both_legs: two trades; daily return is their mean
arms.nature_and_power: 149 of 152 pooled days are SOXL-condition days: effectively a SOXL/SOXS arm; a pass does not imply a QQQ/TQQQ edge. Low power: with ~185 trades and multi-%p dispersion, Holm(8) needs a mean well above 0.34; a true ~0.6 pct-point effect may still fail G6

arms.entry: strict limit C(t-1) - 0.5 * ATR10, active 09:30-15:30; 09:30 open below limit fills at open
arms.r1_overnight_diagnostic: removed (would read blind OOS / excluded block)

arms.signal: first bar 10:00-15:00 with close <= VWAP - 0.6 * ATR14(t-1)
arms.target: resting VWAP sell limit per execution.target_D_only

statistics.daily_aggregation: arithmetic mean of an arm's trades on the same trading day; days without trades omitted
statistics.significance: one-sided circular block bootstrap of mean daily return vs 0.34 pct points
statistics.multiple_testing: holm_8 (sort ascending, multiply i-th by 8-i+1, cumulative max)

screen_gate.G4_split: first floor(n/2) trades in trade_order vs the rest

G8_recent_year.reason: user decision: reflect the 2025-2026 AI/semiconductor-led regime change; 2026 onward (blind OOS, H2) stays unused for selection as the final test in the new regime

inverse_leg_policy.charter_reference: PROJECT_CHARTER section 4: inverse-leg results reported separately, not approved as LONG performance
inverse_leg_policy.report: statistics for all trades, non-inverse leg, inverse leg
inverse_leg_policy.long_listing_requires: non-inverse leg alone: >= 50 trades, >= 25 trading days, and G3, G4, G5, G7, G8 (G7 not applicable if one symbol remains)
inverse_leg_policy.inverse_only_label: INVERSE_ONLY, not listed as a LONG candidate

diagnostics_not_gating: unconditional baseline: for each actual trade i (symbol s, entry minute m), baseline_i = mean over all evaluated valid days of s having bars m and 15:55 of (open_15:55 / open_m - 1) * 100 using bar opens, not stop/limit prices; arm baseline = mean of baseline_i; report trade mean minus baseline mean; D1 exits at its target, so its baseline is a drift reference only
